GAP-001.title: Sale Line Items Lack Barcode, SKU & Point-in-Time Cost Snapshot Persistence
GAP-001.root_cause: sale_items table only stores product_id, quantity, unit_price, and total without capturing barcode, sku, product_name, or unit_cost at transaction time.
GAP-001.current_behavior: Reprints, reports, and COGS calculations must dynamically join current products table, showing altered SKUs/names if master changes.
GAP-001.expected_behavior: sale_items stores immutable snapshot of barcode, sku, product_name, and unit_cost at exact sale timestamp.
GAP-001.offline_sync_impact: Offline carts do not transmit item name/sku snapshot in bulk replay payload.
GAP-001.print_hardware_impact: Thermal and A4 invoice reprints display current master name rather than historical name.
GAP-001.financial_impact: Gross profit margins and COGS analytics distorted by retroactive master cost updates.
GAP-001.operator_impact: Inability to reproduce exact historical invoice text.
GAP-001.failure_scenario: Product name changed from "A" to "B". Customer reprints 6-month-old invoice; document shows "B" instead of "A".
GAP-001.acceptance_criteria: When product master name/price is modified after sale, re-fetching sale details returns point-in-time snapshot unaltered.

GAP-002.title: Product Master Schema Lacks Authoritative Wholesale Pricing Tier Column
GAP-002.root_cause: products table lacks wholesale_price column despite UI exposing wholesale price inputs.
GAP-002.current_behavior: Frontend wholesale price input is discarded on submit; POS offline cart cannot reliably apply wholesale tier.
GAP-002.expected_behavior: products table includes nullable wholesale_price column; POS automatically selects wholesale price when customer type is WHOLESALE.
GAP-002.offline_sync_impact: Catalog delta sync omits wholesale price in IndexedDB product store.
GAP-002.financial_impact: Wholesale customers incorrectly billed at standard retail price.
GAP-002.operator_impact: Cashier must manually override line item unit price on every wholesale checkout.
GAP-002.failure_scenario: Operator enters wholesale price Rs. 85 in product form; upon save, value vanishes and defaults to Rs. 100 retail.
GAP-002.test_requirement: FormRequest validation & product CRUD feature tests
GAP-002.acceptance_criteria: Creating or updating product with wholesale_price persists value and returns it in catalog API and POS cart.

GAP-003.title: Split-Tender Multi-Method Payment Allocations Lack Dedicated Breakdown Persistence
GAP-003.root_cause: sales table only stores single payment_type string (e.g. CASH, BANK, KHATA) without a 1-to-many sale_payments breakdown table.
GAP-003.current_behavior: When sale is paid partially in Cash (Rs. 2000) and Bank (Rs. 3000), single column collapses payment into generic MULTI or primary tender.
GAP-003.expected_behavior: Dedicated sale_payments table records distinct payment method, amount, financial_account_id, and transaction reference per split tender.
GAP-003.offline_sync_impact: Offline bulk sync collapses split tenders into single payment method.
GAP-003.print_hardware_impact: Thermal receipt cannot print separate Cash Paid vs Card Paid lines.
GAP-003.financial_impact: Bank account ledger deposits do not reconcile with actual card payments.
GAP-003.operator_impact: Cash drawer count does not match register closing report.
GAP-003.failure_scenario: Cashier accepts Rs. 1000 cash and Rs. 4000 card for Rs. 5000 sale; register closing shows Rs. 5000 cash overage.
GAP-003.test_requirement: Split tender accounting ledger invariant tests
GAP-003.acceptance_criteria: Split cash + card payment creates separate ledger entries in CashLedger and AccountMovement matching exact split amounts.

GAP-004.title: Inventory Physical Count Stock Adjustment Bypasses Valuation Adjustment Account
GAP-004.root_cause: InventoryService@adjust updates branch_inventories and logs inventory_movements but creates no financial entry in financial_accounts.
GAP-004.current_behavior: Adjusting stock quantity on hand writes off or creates stock without adjusting total balance sheet inventory asset value.
GAP-004.expected_behavior: Stock adjustments post debit/credit movement to designated Inventory Valuation / Stock Loss Account.
GAP-004.offline_sync_impact: Offline bulk adjustments skip valuation entries during ingest.
GAP-004.financial_impact: Discrepancy between physical inventory valuation and general ledger asset accounts.
GAP-004.operator_impact: Loss/theft write-offs not visible in financial P&L reporting.
GAP-004.failure_scenario: Rs. 50,000 worth of damaged goods written off; P&L shows zero inventory shrinkage expense.
GAP-004.test_requirement: InventoryService stock adjustment valuation unit & feature tests
GAP-004.acceptance_criteria: When stock quantity is reduced via adjustment, an AccountMovement record is created against Inventory Loss Account.

GAP-005.title: Purchase Freight & Landed Costs Not Capitalized Into Product Moving Average Cost
GAP-005.root_cause: PurchaseService creates purchase orders and receiving notes without prorating freight/shipping costs into purchase_items.unit_cost.
GAP-005.current_behavior: Freight charges posted as generic expense rather than capitalized into inventory unit asset valuation.
GAP-005.expected_behavior: Purchase receiving workflow allows optional freight charge allocation, prorating freight over received item quantities to compute true Landed Unit Cost.
GAP-005.print_hardware_impact: GRN Voucher does not display Landed Cost breakdown.
GAP-005.financial_impact: Understatement of inventory valuation and overstatement of gross profit margin on sales.
GAP-005.operator_impact: Inaccurate cost price displayed on pricing screens.
GAP-005.failure_scenario: Imported goods cost Rs. 100/unit + Rs. 20 freight/unit; product cost saved as Rs. 100, causing Rs. 20 profit over-reporting per item sold.
GAP-005.test_requirement: Landed cost proration algorithm unit tests
GAP-005.acceptance_criteria: When freight amount is entered on purchase receiving, purchase_items.unit_cost reflects prorated cost + freight.

GAP-006.title: Purchase Cancellation Does Not Verify If Received Stock Has Already Been Sold
GAP-006.root_cause: PurchaseController@cancel decrements branch_inventories by received quantity without checking quantity_on_hand availability.
GAP-006.current_behavior: Cancelling a purchase of 10 units when only 2 units remain on hand decrements stock to negative 8 units.
GAP-006.expected_behavior: Purchase cancellation verifies quantity_on_hand >= received_quantity; rejects cancellation if stock has been consumed or sold.
GAP-006.financial_impact: Accounts payable cancelled for goods that have already generated cash sales.
GAP-006.operator_impact: Operator accidentally creates negative stock and ledger anomaly.
GAP-006.failure_scenario: Purchase of 100 units received; 90 units sold; manager clicks Cancel Purchase; stock becomes -90.
GAP-006.test_requirement: Purchase cancellation state guard feature tests
GAP-006.acceptance_criteria: Attempting to cancel purchase when quantity_on_hand < received_quantity returns HTTP 422 with clear error message.

GAP-007.title: Inter-Branch Stock Transfer Operates Synchronously Without In-Transit Clearing State
GAP-007.root_cause: InventoryController@transfer immediately decrements source branch and increments destination branch in single call.
GAP-007.current_behavior: Stock disappears from Branch A and instantly appears at Branch B before physical vehicle delivery or driver receiving.
GAP-007.expected_behavior: Two-step transfer flow: Dispatch creates IN_TRANSIT status; Destination Branch Manager confirms receiving before stock increments.
GAP-007.print_hardware_impact: Transfer Dispatch Note lacks receiving sign-off slip.
GAP-007.financial_impact: Inventory shrinkage during transit cannot be isolated to carrier or branch.
GAP-007.operator_impact: Destination branch cashier sees stock online and promises customer items not yet physically arrived.
GAP-007.failure_scenario: Branch A transfers 20 items to Branch B; truck lost in transit; Branch B system shows 20 items available for sale.
GAP-007.acceptance_criteria: Transfer creates IN_TRANSIT record; destination branch stock only increases after explicit receiveTransfer API call.

GAP-008.title: Modifying Customer ID on Posted Sale Creates Silent Khata Ledger Drift
GAP-008.root_cause: SaleController@update allows updating customer_id on posted credit sales without reconciling Khata transactions.
GAP-008.current_behavior: Editing sale customer changes sales.customer_id, leaving khata_transactions attached to old customer, desynchronizing balances.
GAP-008.expected_behavior: customer_id on posted sales is immutable; corrections must execute through reversal and new sale creation.
GAP-008.financial_impact: Customer A billed for Customer B's purchases; ledger audit totals mismatch.
GAP-008.operator_impact: Customer disputes statement containing wrong invoices.
GAP-008.failure_scenario: Sale of Rs. 10,000 changed from Customer X to Customer Y in edit modal; Customer X statement still includes Rs. 10,000 debt.
GAP-008.test_requirement: Posted sale immutability API policy tests
GAP-008.acceptance_criteria: Attempting to update customer_id on posted sale returns HTTP 422 Unprocessable Entity.

GAP-009.title: Customer Payment Reversal Lacks Guard Against Secondary Over-Collection Reversal Race
GAP-009.root_cause: CustomerPaymentController@reverse does not verify if subsequent payments or adjustments have altered net receivable balance.
GAP-009.current_behavior: Reversing a payment when customer balance is near zero or in credit creates negative balance without validation.
GAP-009.expected_behavior: CustomerPayment reversal executes within DB transaction, verifies resulting balance validity, and logs compensating Khata event.
GAP-009.financial_impact: Double debiting of customer account upon repeated reversal click.
GAP-009.operator_impact: Cashier double-clicks reverse button creating duplicate debt reversals.
GAP-009.failure_scenario: Operator clicks reverse twice rapidly; two reversal transactions created, doubling customer receivable debt.
GAP-009.acceptance_criteria: Repeated customer payment reversal requests reject duplicate execution with HTTP 409 Conflict.

GAP-010.title: Sale Return Workflow Lacks Granular Restock Condition / Scrap Decision Flag
GAP-010.root_cause: SaleController@returns automatically increments branch inventory for all returned items without restock condition check.
GAP-010.current_behavior: Damaged/expired items returned by customers automatically put back into sellable inventory on hand.
GAP-010.expected_behavior: Sale return line item accepts is_restockable boolean and return_reason; non-restockable items route to Scrap/Damage Ledger.
GAP-010.print_hardware_impact: Return receipt does not indicate item condition.
GAP-010.financial_impact: Damaged scrap goods counted as sellable balance sheet assets.
GAP-010.operator_impact: Damaged returned item resold to next customer causing complaint.
GAP-010.failure_scenario: Customer returns broken glass jar; system puts jar back into active stock; cashier sells broken jar to another buyer.
GAP-010.test_requirement: Sale return restock vs scrap branch inventory tests
GAP-010.acceptance_criteria: When is_restockable is false, branch_inventories quantity_on_hand does not increase; item logged to inventory_movements as DAMAGED_SCRAP.

GAP-011.title: Missing Dedicated Supplier Return / Debit Note Workflow With Stock Reversal & AP Deduction
GAP-011.root_cause: HBOS lacks a supplier_returns table and dedicated controller for returning defective goods to suppliers.
GAP-011.current_behavior: Operator must manually adjust inventory down and manually edit supplier balance without audit linkage.
GAP-011.expected_behavior: Formal Supplier Return / Debit Note workflow decrements inventory, creates supplier AP debit entry, and generates printable Debit Note.
GAP-011.print_hardware_impact: Missing Supplier Debit Note voucher print template.
GAP-011.financial_impact: Supplier overpaid for returned defective goods due to missing AP debit note.
GAP-011.operator_impact: Manual workarounds cause accounting disputes with vendors.
GAP-011.failure_scenario: Store returns Rs. 20,000 defective batch to supplier; no debit note created; accountant pays full invoice.
GAP-011.test_requirement: Supplier return debit note integration tests
GAP-011.acceptance_criteria: Creating supplier return decrements branch inventory and reduces supplier current_balance by exact return value.

GAP-012.title: Supplier Payment Mutation Lacks Automated Reversal Mechanism With AP Re-Accrual
GAP-012.root_cause: SupplierPaymentController lacks a reversal endpoint to void bounced checks or misallocated disbursements.
GAP-012.current_behavior: Bounced or erroneous supplier payments cannot be reversed; requires manual database intervention.
GAP-012.expected_behavior: SupplierPaymentController@reverse marks payment REVERSED, restores supplier payable balance, and credits back financial account.
GAP-012.financial_impact: Bank cash disbursed without corresponding active supplier payment record.
GAP-012.operator_impact: Accountant unable to undo wrong disbursement entry.
GAP-012.failure_scenario: Supplier check bounces; accountant unable to reverse payment record; supplier ledger shows paid.
GAP-012.test_requirement: Supplier payment reversal AP balance restore tests
GAP-012.acceptance_criteria: POST /api/v1/supplier-payments/{id}/reverse marks payment REVERSED and re-accrues supplier AP balance.

GAP-013.title: Operating Expense Entry Allows Null Financial Account Creating Unallocated Cash Drift
GAP-013.root_cause: expenses table and ExpenseRequest permit financial_account_id to be NULL or unassigned.
GAP-013.current_behavior: Expenses logged without financial_account_id create expense records without deducting from Cash Drawer or Bank Account.
GAP-013.expected_behavior: financial_account_id is strictly required on all expense entries, posting mandatory debit to Expense and credit to FinancialAccount.
GAP-013.offline_sync_impact: Offline expense outbox permits null account.
GAP-013.print_hardware_impact: Expense payment voucher lacks paying account name.
GAP-013.financial_impact: Financial account balance statement overstates actual cash on hand.
GAP-013.operator_impact: Cashier records expense but physical drawer cash does not reconcile with bank ledger.
GAP-013.failure_scenario: Cashier pays utility bill Rs. 5,000 from cash drawer with null account; financial accounts show Rs. 5,000 cash that does not exist.
GAP-013.test_requirement: Expense creation mandatory financial account FormRequest tests
GAP-013.acceptance_criteria: Attempting to create expense without valid financial_account_id fails validation with HTTP 422.

GAP-014.title: Soft-Deleting Operating Expense Leaves Associated AccountMovement Row Active
GAP-014.root_cause: ExpenseController@destroy soft deletes expense row but does not reverse or delete corresponding AccountMovement.
GAP-014.current_behavior: Deleting an expense keeps the cash/bank deduction active in financial accounts, causing permanent balance distortion.
GAP-014.expected_behavior: Voiding or deleting expense triggers atomic reversal of AccountMovement within same DB transaction.
GAP-014.financial_impact: Bank/cash account understated by deleted expense amount.
GAP-014.operator_impact: Operator deletes accidental expense entry but cash balance fails to return to actual drawer count.
GAP-014.failure_scenario: Typo expense of Rs. 50,000 entered and immediately deleted; cash account permanently depleted by Rs. 50,000.
GAP-014.test_requirement: Expense deletion cascading movement reversal unit tests
GAP-014.acceptance_criteria: When expense is deleted/voided, associated AccountMovement is reversed and financial account balance restored.

GAP-015.title: UI-Only Authorization for High-Risk Destructive Operations Lacks Backend Policy Enforcement
GAP-015.root_cause: Voiding sales and voiding expenses are hidden in Vue UI for non-owners, but backend controllers lack Gate::authorize or FormRequest role check.
GAP-015.current_behavior: A Salesperson with valid Sanctum token can directly POST to /api/v1/sales/{id}/cancel or /api/v1/expenses/{id}/void via cURL.
GAP-015.expected_behavior: Backend controllers enforce Gate::authorize('cancel', $sale) verifying user has Business Owner or Branch Manager role.
GAP-015.financial_impact: Unauthorized deletion of revenue sales by rogue staff.
GAP-015.operator_impact: Cashier voids sale and pockets cash without manager oversight.
GAP-015.failure_scenario: Cashier calls cancel sale API directly, voiding customer invoice and pocketing Rs. 10,000 cash.
GAP-015.test_requirement: Role authorization HTTP 403 regression security tests
GAP-015.acceptance_criteria: Salesperson attempting to cancel sale or void expense receives HTTP 403 Forbidden.

GAP-016.title: Implicit Route Model Binding Queries Records Across Tenants Before ResolveActiveBusiness Scope
GAP-016.root_cause: Laravel implicit route model binding (e.g. {sale}) resolves model ID globally before ResolveActiveBusiness global scope applies.
GAP-016.current_behavior: Querying an existing record ID from another tenant triggers 403 rather than 404, leaking ID existence across tenant boundaries.
GAP-016.expected_behavior: All route model bindings scope automatically to active business_id, returning HTTP 404 for records outside active tenant.
GAP-016.failure_scenario: Tenant A probes GET /api/v1/sales/500 and discovers Tenant B has reached 500 sales invoices.
GAP-016.test_requirement: Cross-tenant route model binding HTTP 404 security tests
GAP-016.acceptance_criteria: Attempting to fetch resource ID belonging to another business returns HTTP 404 Not Found.

GAP-017.title: Sale Store Endpoint Accepts Arbitrary branch_id In Request Payload Without User Assignment Check
GAP-017.root_cause: SaleController@store takes branch_id directly from request payload without validating if authenticated user is assigned to that branch.
GAP-017.current_behavior: Cashier assigned to Branch 1 can post sale under Branch 2, deducting inventory and posting revenue to wrong branch.
GAP-017.expected_behavior: SaleService forces branch_id to user->branch_id unless user has Business Owner role with explicit multi-branch override permission.
GAP-017.offline_sync_impact: Offline bulk sync injects user branch_id if missing, but allows arbitrary branch_id if payload contains it.
GAP-017.print_hardware_impact: Receipt prints wrong branch name and address.
GAP-017.financial_impact: Branch revenue allocations and sales commissions credited to wrong branch.
GAP-017.operator_impact: Operator posts sale against wrong branch.
GAP-017.failure_scenario: Cashier in Lahore branch changes branch_id to 2 in payload; Karachi branch stock decremented by 5 units.
GAP-017.test_requirement: Branch assignment authorization unit & feature tests
GAP-017.acceptance_criteria: Sale creation strictly restricts branch_id to cashier assigned branch_id unless authorized as Business Owner.

GAP-018.title: Server Trusts Client-Calculated Sale Totals & Discounts Without Server Recalculation
GAP-018.root_cause: SaleService trusts total_amount and discount submitted in client payload rather than computing total from verified line items.
GAP-018.current_behavior: Client can submit line items totaling Rs. 10,000 with a client-supplied total of Rs. 1,000, which server writes to DB.
GAP-018.expected_behavior: SaleService recalculates line item subtotal, applies tax/discount rules server-side, and validates client total matches server total.
GAP-018.offline_sync_impact: Offline bulk sync ingests client-calculated totals blindly.
GAP-018.financial_impact: Severe revenue leakage from tampered client total calculations.
GAP-018.failure_scenario: Malicious or buggy mobile client sends 10 items @ Rs. 1000 each with total = Rs. 100; customer pays Rs. 100.
GAP-018.acceptance_criteria: Sale creation rejects payloads where sum(items.total) - discount + tax != total with HTTP 422.

GAP-019.title: Sale Return Refund Settlement Endpoint Lacks Client Request UUID Deduplication
GAP-019.root_cause: SaleReturnRefundController@settleRefund does not check for request UUID / idempotency_key.
GAP-019.current_behavior: Network drop or double-click on "Settle Refund" executes settleRefund twice, disbursing double cash refund from financial account.
GAP-019.expected_behavior: settleRefund requires idempotency_key header or UUID, rejecting repeated requests with HTTP 409 or returning cached result.
GAP-019.financial_impact: Double cash refund disbursed to customer.
GAP-019.operator_impact: Cashier double clicks button on slow connection.
GAP-019.failure_scenario: Cashier clicks Settle Refund Rs. 3,000 twice; two bank withdrawals of Rs. 3,000 executed (total Rs. 6,000 lost).
GAP-019.acceptance_criteria: Repeated refund settlement calls with same idempotency_key return identical single transaction response without double debit.

GAP-020.title: Purchase GRN Receiving Lacks Pessimistic Row Lock on branch_inventories
GAP-020.root_cause: PurchaseService@receivePurchase updates branch_inventories without using DB lockForUpdate().
GAP-020.current_behavior: Concurrent POS checkout and purchase receiving on same product can cause lost update on quantity_on_hand.
GAP-020.expected_behavior: All inventory mutations lock target branch_inventories row with lockForUpdate() during transaction.
GAP-020.financial_impact: Stock quantity divergence causes wrong inventory asset valuation.
GAP-020.operator_impact: Physical stock count does not match system quantity.
GAP-020.failure_scenario: Cashier sells 1 unit while receiving dock adds 10 units at exact same millisecond; final stock becomes +10 instead of +9.
GAP-020.test_requirement: Parallel concurrency stock update integration tests
GAP-020.acceptance_criteria: Parallel execution of 10 sales and 10 receipts on same product yields exact mathematical net balance.

GAP-021.title: POS Checkout Dispatches Thermal Receipt Printing Before Verified HTTP Commit Confirmation
GAP-021.root_cause: PosSaleView.vue triggers printerService.printReceipt() immediately upon form submit before await api.post() returns.
GAP-021.current_behavior: Paper receipt prints in cashier hands even if backend rejects transaction due to validation or server crash.
GAP-021.expected_behavior: Printing is triggered ONLY after HTTP 200/201 response is received (or after confirmed local IndexedDB outbox commit in offline mode).
GAP-021.offline_sync_impact: In offline mode, receipt must carry clear "OFFLINE PENDING SYNC" indicator.
GAP-021.print_hardware_impact: Prevents printing phantom receipts for failed transactions.
GAP-021.financial_impact: Customer leaves store with physical proof of purchase for uncommitted transaction.
GAP-021.operator_impact: Cashier assumes transaction succeeded because receipt came out of printer.
GAP-021.failure_scenario: Credit limit exceeded; server returns HTTP 422; printer prints receipt; cashier hands items to customer.
GAP-021.test_requirement: POS checkout print dispatch ordering component tests
GAP-021.acceptance_criteria: Thermal print dispatch executes strictly inside .then() block after confirmed HTTP commit or localDb outbox write.

GAP-022.title: Offline POS Terminals Lack Distributed Stock Reservations Permitting Inventory Double-Spend
GAP-022.root_cause: BulkSyncService accepts offline sales blindly during ingest without checking if cached stock was concurrently depleted by another lane.
GAP-022.current_behavior: Two disconnected counters sell 5 available units each; on sync, server accepts both and drops stock to -5.
GAP-022.expected_behavior: Server ingests offline sales into inventory movement ledger, flags NEGATIVE_STOCK_DEFICIT audit alert, and notifies store manager.
GAP-022.offline_sync_impact: Bulk ingest flags over-sold inventory movements with explicit warning status.
GAP-022.financial_impact: Revenue collected for physical inventory that cannot be fulfilled.
GAP-022.operator_impact: Store manager receives automated notification to restock deficit items.
GAP-022.failure_scenario: Two offline lanes sell last 5 bags of cement simultaneously; total 10 bags sold; store physically lacks 5 bags.
GAP-022.test_requirement: Bulk sync inventory deficit audit logging tests
GAP-022.acceptance_criteria: When bulk sync ingests sales causing stock < 0, an audit log entry event=inventory_oversold is created with notifications.

GAP-023.title: Offline Customer Khata Balance Projection Displays Stale Balance During Concurrent Online Settlements
GAP-023.root_cause: IndexedDB customers store is only refreshed on delta sync; offline POS displays cached balance without staleness warning.
GAP-023.current_behavior: Customer settles debt at main branch; offline counter still displays old debt and denies credit sale.
GAP-023.expected_behavior: POS UI displays "Offline Snapshot: Balance as of [timestamp]" warning when operating disconnected.
GAP-023.offline_sync_impact: Client shows clear visual indicator that balance is offline estimate.
GAP-023.print_hardware_impact: Thermal receipt marks customer balance as "Estimated Offline Balance".
GAP-023.financial_impact: Risk of incorrect credit denial or over-extension.
GAP-023.operator_impact: Cashier informed that customer balance may have changed online.
GAP-023.failure_scenario: Customer cleared balance 10 mins ago online; cashier refuses sale claiming customer has unpaid debt.
GAP-023.test_requirement: Offline customer balance staleness indicator UI tests
GAP-023.acceptance_criteria: When navigator.onLine is false, customer dropdown in POS displays warning badge with last synced timestamp.

GAP-024.title: Peer-to-Peer Device Pairing Service Lacks IP Address & Private Subnet Boundary Validation
GAP-024.root_cause: devicePairingService.js accepts any local_ip and port from QR payload without validating RFC 1918 private subnet ranges.
GAP-024.current_behavior: Mobile app will attempt to connect to public or malicious IP addresses if presented with a fraudulent QR code.
GAP-024.expected_behavior: devicePairingService validates IP matches 192.168.x.x, 10.x.x.x, or 172.16-31.x.x before initiating fetch handshake.
GAP-024.offline_sync_impact: P2P asset sync restricted strictly to safe LAN boundaries.
GAP-024.operator_impact: Clear error message when scanning QR from outside local store Wi-Fi network.
GAP-024.failure_scenario: Operator scans QR containing public IP; mobile app attempts HTTP request leaking ephemeral pairing token.
GAP-024.test_requirement: IP subnet validation unit tests in devicePairingService
GAP-024.acceptance_criteria: Scanning QR with non-RFC1918 IP rejects connection with "Invalid Local Subnet IP" error toast.

GAP-025.title: Offline Quick Customer Creation Lacks Persistent Temp-to-Server ID Mapping Graph
GAP-025.root_cause: When customer is created offline in POS modal, temporary UUID is assigned locally but sale payload links raw temp ID.
GAP-025.current_behavior: If offline sale references an offline-created customer, BulkSyncService fails foreign key customer_id lookup if order is wrong.
GAP-025.expected_behavior: BulkSyncService supports customers batch ingest in bulk-transactions payload, creating customer first and remapping temporary UUID to server customer ID for sales.
GAP-025.offline_sync_impact: Enables seamless offline creation of customer followed immediately by credit sale on same tablet.
GAP-025.print_hardware_impact: Receipt displays newly created customer name properly.
GAP-025.financial_impact: Credit sale correctly attached to new customer Khata rather than defaulting to walk-in.
GAP-025.operator_impact: Cashier can add new customer and charge sale on credit without internet.
GAP-025.failure_scenario: Cashier adds new customer offline and sells Rs. 10,000 on credit; on sync, customer is missing on server and sale fails or defaults to walk-in.
GAP-025.test_requirement: Bulk sync parent-child customer temp-ID remapping tests
GAP-025.acceptance_criteria: Bulk sync payload containing new customer UUID and sale referencing same UUID ingests customer first and correctly links sale.

GAP-026.title: Critical Destructive Mutations Lack Explicit Modal Confirmation Dialogs
GAP-026.root_cause: UI buttons for voiding expenses, deleting suppliers, and deactivating branches trigger actions with simple single-click.
GAP-026.current_behavior: Accidental click on "Void" or "Delete" immediately dispatches mutation without confirmation prompt.
GAP-026.expected_behavior: All destructive mutations trigger a standardized ConfirmActionModal requiring operator confirmation.
GAP-026.financial_impact: Accidental cancellation of valid financial disbursements.
GAP-026.operator_impact: Operator slips on touchscreen and voids wrong expense.
GAP-026.failure_scenario: Cashier accidentally taps trash can icon next to Rs. 100,000 rent expense; expense instantly voided.
GAP-026.test_requirement: Modal confirmation UI component interaction tests
GAP-026.acceptance_criteria: Clicking destructive action opens modal with Cancel and Confirm buttons; API call fires only upon Confirm.

GAP-027.title: POS Screen Lacks Persistent Active Operating Branch & Shift Indicator in Header
GAP-027.root_cause: PosSaleView.vue header displays store name but omits active branch name and active cashier shift identifier.
GAP-027.current_behavior: Operator with access to multiple branches cannot verify which branch stock and cash drawer they are operating in.
GAP-027.expected_behavior: POS top navigation persistently displays Branch Badge, Current User Name, and Online/Offline Sync Indicator.
GAP-027.offline_sync_impact: Operator clearly sees whether POS is in Offline Mode.
GAP-027.financial_impact: Operator rings up sales under wrong branch account.
GAP-027.failure_scenario: Manager switches to branch B to check stock, then forgets and rings up sales at branch A counter.
GAP-027.test_requirement: POS header branch context rendering tests
GAP-027.acceptance_criteria: POS screen header prominently displays active branch name, active cashier, and connectivity badge at all times.

GAP-028.title: Legacy Unrouted ProductInvoiceView Component Creates Codebase Confusion
GAP-028.root_cause: Frontend/src/views/Invoices/ProductInvoiceView.vue is an unrouted prototype component superseded by printerService.js.
GAP-028.current_behavior: Component exists in repo but is not referenced in router/index.js, causing developer ambiguity on active invoice pipeline.
GAP-028.expected_behavior: ProductInvoiceView.vue is either formally integrated as A4 preview modal or marked deprecated/removed.
GAP-028.print_hardware_impact: Clarifies that printerService.js is authoritative print engine.
GAP-028.failure_scenario: Developer updates styling in ProductInvoiceView.vue expecting print layout to change, with zero actual effect.
GAP-028.test_requirement: Router dead code audit verification tests
GAP-028.acceptance_criteria: Unrouted invoice component replaced with standard printable preview modal integrated with printerService.js.

GAP-029.title: Employee HR Wage, Salary Amount & Payment Cycle Discarded Without Database Schema Persistence
GAP-029.root_cause: StaffModal.vue captures salary_amount, payment_cycle, and next_payment_date (FIELD-150, 151, 152), but users table lacks salary/payroll columns and Employee model does not exist in schema.
GAP-029.current_behavior: Operator enters employee salary and pay cycle in Staff Modal; data is discarded upon save and omitted from backend database.
GAP-029.expected_behavior: Add salary_amount, payment_cycle, and next_payment_date columns to users table (or dedicated employees table), persisting staff payroll terms.
GAP-029.print_hardware_impact: Salary slip print template cannot read employee contractual pay.
GAP-029.financial_impact: Payroll forecasting and upcoming wage liability reporting non-functional.
GAP-029.operator_impact: HR operator re-enters employee salary repeatedly with zero persistence.

GAP-029.test_requirement: User governance payroll fields FormRequest & CRUD tests

GAP-030.title: Customer Secondary Phone & Alternate Contact Number Discarded Without Schema Persistence
GAP-030.root_cause: CustomerModal.vue captures secondary_phone (FIELD-093), but customers table only contains single phone column.
GAP-030.current_behavior: Customer secondary phone number entered in UI form is discarded on submit.
GAP-030.expected_behavior: customers table contains nullable secondary_phone column to store alternate customer contact.
GAP-030.offline_sync_impact: Customer sync payload carries secondary phone.
GAP-030.operator_impact: Operator cannot contact customer when primary phone is unreachable.
GAP-030.failure_scenario: Operator adds customer secondary mobile number for Khata recovery; number vanishes after saving.
GAP-030.test_requirement: Customer secondary_phone validation & CRUD feature tests
GAP-030.acceptance_criteria: Creating or updating customer with secondary_phone persists value in database and IndexedDB cache.

GAP-031.title: Expense Category Monthly Budget Cap Limit Discarded Without Schema Persistence
GAP-031.root_cause: ExpenseCategoryModal.vue captures monthly_budget (FIELD-140), but expense_categories table lacks monthly_budget column.
GAP-031.current_behavior: Monthly budget limit entered in Expense Category form is discarded on submit.
GAP-031.expected_behavior: expense_categories table contains nullable monthly_budget decimal column, enabling Budget vs Actual reporting.
GAP-031.financial_impact: Budget variance tracking and over-budget alert notifications impossible.
GAP-031.operator_impact: Store owner cannot enforce departmental budget ceilings.
GAP-031.failure_scenario: Owner sets monthly utility budget to Rs. 50,000; value is not saved and no over-budget warnings trigger.
GAP-031.test_requirement: Expense category monthly_budget FormRequest & model tests
GAP-031.acceptance_criteria: Expense category creation with monthly_budget stores decimal value and displays budget cap on expense summary dashboard.
